 Veterans Day 2026 Free Meals, Freebies and Deals 
 November 05, 2026 
 Veterans Day 2026 Free Meals, Freebies and Deals
 Veterans Day 
 News 
 A list of restaurant, retail and attraction deals for veterans, servicemembers and their family.
 The American Legion presents its annual list of Veterans Day deals and discounts for veterans, servicemembers and their families. This list was compiled by staff research and verified, wherever possible, with the business. 
 Please note that these offers are subject to change and may not be available in all areas. It is recommended that you verify with the restaurant, retailer or other business you plan to visit.
 If you are a business and would like to add your Veterans Day offer to our list, please contact us here .   
 Veterans Day free meals and restaurant deals
 7 Brew   
On Nov. 11, veterans can enjoy 50% off their drink order at participating 7 Brew stands. We look forward to seeing you and thank you for your service!
 7brew.com/whats-new 
 54 th Street Grill & Bar 
We're honored to serve those who've served our nation. Veterans and active-duty military, join us this Wednesday, Nov. 11 for up to $10 off any entrée. It's our small way of saying thank you. Dine-in only.
 https://www.54thstreetrestaurants.com/ 
 99 Restaurants   Veterans and active duty military, enjoy a FREE LUNCH from our Veterans Day menu with any entrée purchase on 11/11, opening – 4 p.m. Military ID required. 
 99restaurants.com/ 
 110 Grill
  All veterans and active-duty military receive a complimentary lunch on 11/11 from a select menu until 4 p.m.
 110grill.com/ 
 Applebee’s For the 19th consecutive year, we’re offering veterans and active duty military a special Veterans Day meal on Wednesday 11/11, where they can select from delicious entrées at Applebee’s across the country (Dine-in only).
 applebees.com/en/veterans-day-free-meals 
 American Dairy Association of Indiana
 Veterans, active-duty servicemembers and their family can visit the Indiana State Fair Dairy Bar on Wednesday, Nov. 11 from 11 a.m.- 2 p.m. for a FREE milkshake.
 Friends and Dairy Bar fans can purchase a milkshake for $5. All proceeds benefit the American Legion Department of Indiana.
 facebook.com/photo?fbid=1571281381712967&set=a.551901110317671 
 Another Broken Egg Café
 This Veterans Day, all veterans, active-duty and retired servicemembers are invited to enjoy a FREE Patriot French toast combo & coffee on Nov. 11 . 
 facebook.com/photo?fbid=1696201829211466&set=a.713606010804391 Aspen Creek In honor of Veterans day, Aspen Creek Grill will supply free meal vouchers to all veterans and active-duty military at their locations on Nov. 11. Any current or former military member can visit their Aspen Creek Grill location between 11 a.m. and 6 p.m. on Nov. 11 to pick up their $15 voucher to use on the restaurant’s dishes. The voucher will be eligible for redemption at any Aspen Creek Grill location starting immediately on Nov. 11 through Dec. 24. The offer is valid for dine-in visits only and excludes alcoholic beverages.
 In addition to the vouchers, Aspen creek Grill will also continue its annual tradition of setting a “Fallen Soldiers table” on Veterans day.
 aspencreekgrill.com/veterans/ 
 Backyard Taco
 Free meal for veterans and active-duty servicemembers on Nov. 11. Valid at all Backyard Taco locations. Valid military ID required.
 backyardtaco.com/veterans-eat-free/ 
 Bad Daddy’s Burger Bar Bad Daddy’s Burger Bar is honoring veterans and active duty service members with a complimentary meal this Veterans Day. On Nov. 11, all veterans and active-duty service members will receive a FREE BD’s All-American Burger with cheese and a classic side from 11-4 PM as a small thank you for their service.
 Offer valid on Wednesday, Nov. 11 from 11a.m. - 4 p.m. for dine-in customers only. Must show valid military ID or proof of service.   
 baddaddysburgerbar.com/ 
 Bandanas BBQ 
This Veterans Day, Nov. 11, we want to show our appreciation to all veterans and active-duty military members. Stop by any of our restaurants and enjoy a FREE pulled pork sandwich with your choice of one side when dining in. Must present a military ID or proof of service. Dine-in only. No substitutions allowed.
 bandanasbbq.com/ 
 Benihana This Veterans Day, Benihana proudly honors active military, veterans, first responders, and Gold Star families with a special dine-in offer created to bring family and friends together around the hibachi grill.
 From Monday Nov. 9 through Wednesday Nov. 11, eligible guests can enjoy a complimentary five-course hibachi entrée with the purchase of an appetizer. Choose from: hibachi chicken, hibachi steak, hibachi salmon. Each entrée includes our signature five-course Benihana experience featuring: onion soup, Benihana salad, hibachi shrimp appetizer, hibachi vegetables, steamed rice
 Veterans Day is a special day to honor those who serve and sacrifice. Join us at Benihana and celebrate with great food, incredible showmanship and a complimentary hibachi entrée for our heroes. Reserve your table and make Veterans Day a memorable one.
 benihana.com/happenings/celebrate-veterans-day-at-benihana/ 
 Biggby Coffee
 Veterans and active-duty military members can receive a free 16-ounce hot or iced brewed coffee. Through the offer, BIGGBY® COFFEE is thanking those who have served while continuing to build relationships in the communities its stores serve.
 biggby.com/ 
 Bibibop 
From Monday, Nov. 9 through Friday, Nov. 13, veterans and active-duty military personnel can enjoy one free fountain drink or lemonade at BIBIBOP. Just bring a valid military or veteran ID, such as a veteran ID Card, VA Health ID, military ID, or a driver’s license with a veteran designation. No purchase necessary, so stop in for a drink or stay for a bowl!
 bibibop.com/2026/11/07/thank-you-veterans-free-drinks-on-us-all-week-long/ Biscuit Belly On Veterans Day, Nov. 11, we are offering a seat and complimentary meal to each of our veterans at any Biscuit Belly location. We proudly offer a daily 10% discount to all veterans, active-duty servicemembers and first responders as a small, continued gesture of our appreciation
 biscuitbelly.com/biscuit-bellys-veterans-day-celebration-a-seat-for-those-who-served/ 
 Blaze Pizza   On Wednesday, Nov. 11, veterans and active-duty military personnel are invited to visit participating Blaze Pizza locations nationwide for a free one-topping pizza. The offer is a gesture of gratitude for their service and sacrifice.
 blazepizza.com/ 
 Bob Evans On Veterans Day, Nov. 11, veterans and active-duty military receive a free meal from our special Veterans Day menu. Choose from 11 homestyle favorites, free for veterans and active-duty military at their local Bob Evans restaurant.
 bobevans.com/veterans-day 
 Bonefish Grill As part of its ongoing tradition of honoring those who serve, Bonefish Grill invites veterans, active-duty and retired military members, first responders and their families to dine at any Bonefish Grill location on Veterans Day, Nov. 11, and receive a complimentary order of Bang Bang Shrimp and a nonalcoholic beverage.
 bonefishgrill.com/ 
 Brickhouse Tavern + Tap 
We honor those who have served and invite veterans to enjoy 20% off their meal when they dine-in this Veterans Day, November 11. Valid for parties up to four with valid military ID. Valid on dine-in only. Not valid on alcoholic beverages or retail purchases. Not valid with any other discount. Tax and gratuity not included. Valid only on Veterans Day, November 11, 2026. Must show valid ID. 
 brickhousetavernandtap.com/event/veterans-day-2026/ 
 Bruegger’s Bagels        Bruegger’s Bagels is offering a free bagel and shmear AND free coffee on Veterans Day.
 brueggers.com/ 
 Bombshells 
 Bombshells Restaurant & Bar will salute veterans and active-duty military by offering free meals (includes appetizer, entrée and dessert) on Wednesday, Nov. 11 at all locations in Texas and Colorado. Accompanying family members receive a 20% discount on their meals. Soft drinks and alcoholic beverages are excluded from both offers.
 4bombshells.com/ 
 Bubbakoo’s Burritos On Wednesday, Nov. 11, Bubbakoo’s is honoring veterans and active-duty military members with a free chicken or beef burrito or bowl. The offer is available all day in-restaurant with a valid military ID and no purchase is required. The offer is valid for in-restaurant orders only, with additional charges for modifiers and add-ons.
 bubbakoos.com/ 
 Bubba’s 33 Join us for a free lunch Wednesday, Nov. 11 available until 4 p.m. Active, former or retired military only. ID may be required. Offer is limited to select entrees and cannot be used with any other offers or discounts.
 bubbas33.com/ 
 Buca di Beppo Buca di Beppo will give a free lunch entrée to veterans and active-duty military on Wednesday, Nov. 11, 11 a.m. – 3 p.m. at all Buca di Beppo locations nationwide, dine-in only. Valid military ID or proof of service required.
 dineatbuca.com/locations 
 Buffalo’s Café 
Veterans and active-duty military members can receive 25% off their meal when dining in at participating locations on Nov. 11. The offer excludes alcohol and requires proof of veteran or military status.
 buffalos.com/ 
 Buffalo Wild Wings For one day only, veterans and active-duty military members can enjoy 10 FREE boneless wings + fries with valid proof of service at participating Buffalo Wild Wings sports bars, dine-in only. At participating Buffalo Wild Wings GO locations, the same offer is available for walk-in orders with a $5 minimum purchase. 
 Beyond Veterans Day, B-Dubs shows its appreciation year-round with a 15% discount for active military, veterans and first responders at participating locations. 
 buffalowildwings.com/ 
 Calhoun’s 
At Calhoun’s, we’re grateful for the men and women who have served our country 🇺🇸. This Veterans Day, we’re honored to show our appreciation by offering veterans a free meal on Nov. 11.
 calhouns.com/ 
 California Pizza Kitchen Join us on Wednesday, Nov. 11 for your choice of one complimentary beverage and one entrée from a select menu. Must be in uniform or show your military ID or other proof of service.
 cpk.com/veteransday 
 California Tortilla 
This Veteran’s Day, Wednesday, Nov. 11, we invite all active and retired military to enjoy a FREE TACO as our way of saying “thank you.” Just bring in your military ID to show the cashier and enjoy! One per person. Military ID required. Not valid with any other offers
 californiatortilla.com/veterans-day/ 
 Casey’s 
As a small token of our great appreciation to those who have served, we are happy to provide a complimentary Fountain Drink or Coffee for veterans this Veterans Day. If you're a veteran getting this offer is simple. Just visit any Casey's store on Nov. 11, provide your military ID or proof of service, and savor a free cup of joe or a refreshing fountain drink. This offer will also extend year-round to all active-duty military personnel and on-duty, uniformed first responders - including law enforcement, fire, and EMS. 
 blog.caseys.com/articles/honoring-heroes-veterans-day-at-caseys 
 Carolina Ale House 
Join us for Veterans Day on Wednesday, Nov. 11. Veterans get to enjoy a free half rack rib platter for the holiday. Please note that this offer is only available at NC, FL and TN locations. Veterans must show proof of military service, dine in only and not valid with any other offers
 carolinaalehouse.com/events/free-ribs-for-veterans 
 Cattlemens Steakhouse 
Cattlemens proudly honors all active, non-active, and retired military personnel with a
 complimentary sirloin steak dinner on Veterans Day. Join us on Veterans Day, Wednesday, Nov. 11 from 4 p.m. to 10 p.m. — no certificate needed. Simply show proof of service to enjoy your complimentary meal.
 If you’re unable to visit on Veterans Day, you can sign up below on or before Nov. 11 to receive a Veterans Day Certificate by email on Nov. 12. The offer will be emailed on Nov. 12, 2026. Offer valid 11/12 – 11/18/26 during regular business hours for dine-in. 
 Due to restaurant operational limitations, offer not valid on takeout orders.  
 Offer valid at California Cattlemens locations only.
 cattlemens.com/veterans/ 
 CentraArchy Restaurants 
At all 15 CentraArchy Restaurants, on Nov. 11, any U.S. veteran or active-duty members of the armed forces with I.D. is invited to enjoy any entrée from the full menu at half price.
 C alifornia Dreaming in Augusta, Ga., Charleston, S.C., Columbia, S.C., Greenville, S.C., Spanish Fort, Ala., and Surfside Beach, S.C.; Carolina Roadhouse in Myrtle Beach, S.C.; Chophouse ’47 in Greenville, S.C.; Chophouse New Orleans, Gulfstream Café in Garden City, S.C.; Joey D’s Oak Room in Atlanta; and New York Prime in Atlanta, Boca Raton, Fla. and Myrtle Beach, S.C., Bon Ton Prime Rib in New Orleans.
 centraarchy.com/happenings/ 
 Cheddar’s Scratch Kitchen Veterans and active military members will receive a complimentary appetizer or dessert on Nov. 11. No purchase necessary. Guests can find their closest restaurant at Cheddars.com. 
 cheddars.com/ 
 Chicken Salad Chick Veterans and active-duty servicemembers are eligible for 50% off any meal with up to two sides and a regular-size drink on Nov. 11 with a valid military ID or in uniform.   
 chickensaladchick.com/ 
 Chili’s Today and every day, we thank you, our veterans and active military members who define selfless service. We look forward to once again showing our gratitude with a FREE Veterans Day meal as a small way to honor your service and the sacrifices you’ve made for our country. Thank you will never be enough.
 All veterans and active military members can get a free meal on Veterans Day, Nov. 11, at all participating Chili's Grill & Bar restaurants. Available in-restaurant only for select items. Please call ahead to your local Chili's if you have any questions about your Veterans Day meals. 
 chilis.com/restaurant-events/veterans-day 
 Chipotle On Wednesday, Nov. 11, active-duty U.S. servicemembers and veterans with valid proof of eligibility can receive their choice of free chips and dip with a $5 in-restaurant purchase. The offer is available all day on Wednesday, Nov. 11, at participating Chipotle restaurants in the U.S. Active-duty U.S. servicemembers and veterans must show valid proof of military or veteran status at checkout. Accepted forms of identification include a valid military ID, VA-issued veteran ID/health ID, a state-issued ID with a Veteran designation or discharge paperwork.
 newsroom.chipotle.com/veterans-day-2026-offer 
 Claim Jumper Free meal for veterans and active military members from a special menu.
 claimjumper.com/menus/veterans-day 
 Clique Hospitality, Las Vegas Valley Clique Hospitality will offer active-duty and retired military personnel a 15% discount throughout November in recognition of Veterans Day, building on its year-round military discount. Guests must provide a military ID to redeem. The discount is available at select Clique restaurants across the Las Vegas Valley, featured below:
 Bottiglia Cucina & Enoteca , located at Green Valley Ranch Resort Spa & Casino in Henderson, serves sophisticated Tuscan-style fare and brunch in a bright and lively indoor dining room and spacious, picturesque patio. The menu is bountiful with antipasti, salads, specialty pasta dishes and weekend brunch favorites, including king crab bucatini with zucchini, roasted tomatoes and lemon cream sauce; and California eggs Benedict with roasted tomato, rotisseries chicken, avocado and pesto, complemented by flavorful cocktails and wines from around the world.
 Borracha Mexican Cantina , also at Green Valley Ranch Resort Spa & Casino in Henderson, brings together flavorful cuisine and cocktails in a vibrant, Dia de los Muertos-inspired setting. Signature dishes include bubbling cheese fundido with asadero and jack cheese, house-made chorizo, guacamole, pickled red onion and cherry tomato pico de gallo; slow roasted pork carnitas with guacamole, green tomatillo sauce and soft corn tortillas; and brunch favorites such as chilaquiles with two eggs any style, corn tortilla chips, black beans, cotija cheese, avocado, cilantro and oven-roasted tomato arbol sauce.
 Mijo Modern Mexican at Durango Casino & Resort showcases the bold and vibrant flavors of coastal Mexico through an elevated, contemporary lens. The menu features standout dishes such as chicken suiza enchiladas, carne asada and a surf and turf burrito, alongside a lively brunch offering with items like churro French toast and huevos Benedictinos. Guests can also sip on a selection of flavorful margaritas, rare tequilas and signature cocktails, all served in a space inspired by the agave plant and Mexican artistry.
 Hearthstone Kitchen & Cellar , located at Red Rock Casino Resort & Spa in Summerlin, offers a warm and inviting dining experience centered around ingredient-driven, house-made cuisine. The menu features handmade pastas, fresh seafood and signature favorites such as tuna pizza topped with yellowfin tuna, sprigs of fresh cilantro, and drizzled with truffle aioli and olive oil; double-dredged fried chicken with housemade biscuits; and a selection of wood-fired pizzas. The restaurant also offers bottomless weekend brunch, complemented by an expansive wine list and craft cocktails.
 Amaya Modern Mexican , located on the second floor of The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas, delivers a high-energy dining experience inspired by the spirit of Tulum. The menu reimagines Mexican coastal cuisine with bold dishes such as surf and turf, lobster enchiladas and fresh ceviches. Paired with a vibrant cocktail program featuring tequilas and mezcals, the restaurant blends elevated dining with immersive entertainment, including DJs and live performances.
 Colton’s Steak House & Grill
 Veterans enjoy a free meal from a select menu on Nov. 11, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. Valid only at participating location. Dine-in from select menu only.
 coltonssteakhouse.com / Cotton Patch Café On Nov. 11, Cotton Patch Cafe gives active-duty and retired military a free small or regular chicken fried steak or chicken fried chicken. The offer is dine-in only. Both entrées are hand-battered in our kitchens and finished with scratch-made cream gravy, the plate Texans have been ordering at Cotton Patch since we opened in Nacogdoches, Texas, in 1989.
 cottonpatch.com/news/posts/veterans-day-free-meal 
 Cracker Barrel 
Today and always, we’re proud to honor those who have served our country. This Veterans Day, veterans and active-duty military are invited to join us for a breakfast on us, a small gesture of gratitude for your service and sacrifice.
 crackerbarrel.com/ Crooked Pint 
On Wednesday, Nov. 11, veterans and active-duty military members can enjoy one FREE select menu item as a small token of our appreciation for their service and sacrifice. Choose from these Crooked Pint favorites: classic Lucy, cluckin’ good platter, crispy chicken sandwich or apple pecan chicken salad.
 crookedpint.com/ Dave & Buster’s For Veterans Day, D&B will be offering veterans: Free unlimited gameplay all day on blue + green swipe games. No tickets are earned with unlimited play and a free dessert with the purchase of an entrée. daveandbusters.com/ 
 Denny’s
 On Wednesday, Nov. 11, Denny’s will welcome active, non-active and retired military personnel to participating restaurants nationwide for a free Original Grand Slam from 5 a.m. to noon local time. Eligible guests must present a valid military ID or DD-214 to redeem the dine-in offer.
 dennys.com/news/dennys-brings-booth-post-americas-diner-extends-its-veterans-day-thank-you 
 Dickey’s Barbecue Pit 
In honor of Veterans Day, Dickey’s Barbecue Pit is offering military veterans and active-duty personnel a free Pulled Pork Sandwich on Nov. 11. The offer is available open to close for dine-in or carryout with valid military ID. Limit one free sandwich per guest.
 dickeys.com/
 Dog Haus This Veterans Day, Dog Haus is serving up a tasty thank-you to those who have served our country. On Nov. 11, veterans can enjoy any entree free at every Dog Haus. The offer is available for dine-in only and can be redeemed by showing proof of service at checkout, including a military ID, DD-214, VA card or veteran designation on a driver’s license. Limit one free entree per veteran. Offer is not available through the Haus Rewards app. Terms apply.
 https://doghaus.com/ 
 Eat’n Park
 All former and current military personnel receive 10% off for themselves and their entire party each time they dine in — for the entire month of November!  Proof of service is required, so please be prepared to show your military ID or your veteran designation on your driver’s license.  We will also extend this discount to servicemembers who arrive in uniform. The 10% discount will be applied to all meals on the check, so our veterans and active-duty servicemembers are welcome to bring their families to dine with them.   
 https://blog.eatnpark.com/ 
 Eddie Merlot’s This Veterans Day, Eddie Merlot’s is showing its appreciation for those who have served with a free Eddie’s prime cheeseburger and chips for all veterans and active service military members. On Nov. 11, guests with a valid military ID can enjoy the steakhouse favorite at no charge, available for dine-in only as a small token of appreciation for their service.
 eddiemerlots.com/  
 Fazoli’s
 Veterans and military members can enjoy free spaghetti with marinara or meat sauce on Nov. 11 with proof of veteran or military status. No purchase is necessary, and guests can redeem the offer using code VET26 at participating locations.
 https://fazolis.com/ 
 Firebirds Wood Fired Grill Every Veterans Day, we're proud to treat our veterans and active-duty military members to a complimentary meal with the purchase of another entrée. Whether you're a veteran dining with a friend or family member, or you're bringing a veteran to celebrate, their meal is on us! If the Veteran or Active-Duty Service member is dining alone, we will still be happy to cover their meal.
 firebirdsrestaurants.com/ 
 Freddy’s Freddy's Frozen Custard & Steakburgers® is continuing its tradition of honoring those who serve our nation by offering veterans and active-duty military personnel a free Freddy's combo meal card that is suitable for any combo meal on Veterans Day, Wednesday, Nov. 11. No purchase is necessary to receive this special offer. Valid military ID required. Cards may be redeemed through November 25, 2026.   
 freddys.com/veterans-day 
 Frisch’s Big Boy
 We're proud to honor the men and women who have served our country and helped protect the freedoms we enjoy every day. On Wednesday, Nov. 11, veterans can enjoy a FREE Big Boy, fries and drink at participating Frisch's locations. Military ID required. Dine-in only.
 frischs.com/big-boy-menu/ Golden Corral Golden Corral is honoring America’s servicemembers with its annual Military Appreciation Night on Wednesday, Nov. 11, from 4 p.m. to close. All current U.S. service members, retired military and veterans are invited to enjoy a FREE “Thank You” buffet and beverage as a small token of appreciation for their service. Since 2001, Golden Corral’s Military Appreciation Night has served nearly 6.9 million free meals and raised more than $21.5 million for local DAV chapters.   
 https://www.goldencorral.com/military-appreciation/ 
 Gold Star Chili 
On Wednesday, Nov. 11, every Gold Star is celebrating and honoring those who have served our country with a complimentary meal of their choice (up to $12 off their order with proof of service). Please join us at your favorite Gold Star for dine-in, carry out or drive-thru, and lunch or dinner is on us. You proudly served. Now let us serve you!
 goldstarchili.com/veterans-day 
 Green Mill  
 This Veterans Day, Green Mill is proud to recognize the brave men and women who have served our country with a meal on us! On Wednesday, Nov. 11, veterans and active-duty military members can enjoy a FREE select menu item as a small token of our gratitude for their service and sacrifice. Choose from these Green Mill favorites: 2-topping personal pizza, rigatoni bolognese, Western Mill burger, cobb salad with chicken.
 greenmill.com/ 
 Guy Fieri's Vegas Kitchen & Bar in the LINQ Hotel Military and first responders can always order an All American Bacon Burger with fries for $25 (a portion benefits the Guy Fieri Foundation), a free domestic draft beer for active military and veterans, and 25% off meals.
 caesars.com/linq/restaurants/guy-fieris-vegas-kitchen-and-bar 
 Haven Hot Chicken Active or retired military members receive a FREE Tendie Duo in store on Nov. 11.
 havenhotchicken.com/ 
 Hickory Tavern 
As a small token of our appreciation, we're inviting all veterans, active-duty military members, and reservists to enjoy a free entrée on Nov. 11. To all who have answered the call to serve, thank you for your service and sacrifice. We look forward to welcoming you at the Tavern! Valid November 11 only. Guests may choose one complimentary entrée from the following: any burger, fish & chips, chicken tenders, fiesta salad, Buffalo chicken wrap
 hickorytavern.com/ 
 Hof's Hut All veterans and U.S. active duty military receive a $10 Bonus Card and a complimentary Hofburger or pancakes combo when dining in at Hof’s Hut on Wednesday, Nov. 11.
 hofshut.com/veterans-day-meal 
 Hot Dog on a Stick This Veterans Day, Hot Dog on a Stick is honoring those who have served by offering a FREE 16 oz. original lemonade on Nov. 11 to all veterans and active-duty military members. Offer available in-store at participating locations with a valid military ID. No purchase necessary.
 hotdogonastick.com/ 
 Hopdaddy Burger Bar 
In honor of Veterans Day, Hopdoddy Burger Bar is showing appreciation to military veterans and active-duty servicemembers with a special offer. On Wednesday, Nov. 11, all veterans and active military personnel are invited to enjoy a free classic burger or classic burger with cheese, available for dine-in only at all Hopdoddy locations nationwide.
 This annual tradition, which has seen thousands of redemptions each year, is our way of recognizing and honoring the brave individuals who have served our country.
 hopdoddy.com/blog/veterans-day Honey Dew FREE coffee, any size, for all veterans on Wednesday, Nov. 11. One per person per visit.   
 honeydewdonuts.com/locations/ 
 Hurricane Grill & Wings 
Veterans and active-duty military members can enjoy a complimentary entrée when dining in at participating locations on Nov. 11 with proof of veteran or military status. Guests can choose from 10 bone-in or boneless wings, beer-battered fish & chips, a steakburger, chicken Caesar salad, buttermilk crispy chicken sandwich or chicken BLT tacos.
 hurricanewings.com/ 
 IHOP IHOP will offer a free red, white and blueberry pancake combo to veterans and active-duty servicemembers on Veterans Day, Wednesday, Nov. 11, from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. at participating restaurants nationwide.
 The combo includes two buttermilk pancakes topped with glazed strawberries, blueberry topping and whipped topping, served with two eggs, hash browns and a choice of two strips of hickory-smoked bacon or two pork sausage links.
 ihop.com/en/veterans-day 
 Irv’s Burgers This Veterans Day, Irv’s Burgers is honoring those who have served with a FREE Roadside Single Burger on the house. On Nov. 11, all active servicemembers and veterans can stop by Irv’s and enjoy a free burger with proof of service. It’s a small way for the iconic burger stand to show its appreciation for the military community and say thank you to those who have served our country.
 Offer only available for a Roadside Single Burger. One free burger per person. Must show valid proof of service.
 irvsburgers.com/  
 Jaggers Visit your local Jaggers for a veteran’s only offer on Vets Day.
 eatjaggers.com/ 
 J. Christopher’s In honor of our nation’s veterans, J. Christopher is giving a free meal on Nov. 11 to all veterans when they show a valid I.D.
 jchristophers.com/community/ 
 Joe’s Crab Shack We honor those who have served and invite veterans to enjoy 20% off their meal when they dine-in this Veterans Day, Wednesday, Nov. 11.
 joescrabshack.com/event/veterans-day/ 
 Kings Family Restaurant 
This Veterans Day, Kings Family Restaurant is saying THANK YOU with 25% off meals for veterans and active military members on Wednesday, Nov. 11. And as always, we proudly offer 10% off every day as a small token of our gratitude. From our Kings family to yours, thank you for your service!
 kingsfamily.com/ 
 Kona Grill 
This Veterans Day, we’re saying thank you the best way we know how: with a great meal. Veterans, active-duty servicemembers, first responders and Gold Star families get a complimentary entrée with the purchase of any starter, all day for three days.
 konagrill.com/happenings/veterans-day/ 
 Little Caesars 
Little Caesars honors active-duty military, veterans, and reservists with its annual free HOT-N-READY Lunch Combo on Veterans Day and a 10% discount every day at participating restaurants.
 littleceasarsmenu.com/menu/deal-military-discount 
 Logan’s Roadhouse Honoring those who served! This Veterans Day, veterans and active-duty military can enjoy a FREE meal at Logan’s Roadhouse on November 11, 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. Proof of service required. At participating locations.
 facebook.com/share/v/18dxoiC4u6/ 
 LongHorn Steakhouse On Nov. 11, LongHorn Steakhouse is giving veteran and active-duty steak-lovers 10% off their meal, along with a free appetizer or dessert for their table with the purchase of an adult entree. This offer is available for dine-in and call-in orders only. Find the closest location at LongHornSteakhouse.com .  
 Lucille’s BBQ All veterans & U.S. active duty military receive a $10 Bonus Card and a complimentary original pulled pork sandwich or personal size Southern fried chicken when dining in on Nov. 11.
 lucillesbbq.com/veterans-day-meal
